Appraiser remarks
The rear quarter panel on the driver's side shows a long dent with paint transfer along
the edge, and the damage pattern lines up well with a sideswipe during a lane change.
The rear bumper cover has a cracked corner and a scuffed mounting bracket. Several
small scratches sit near the wheel arch, and some of these may be older than this
crash, so they have been noted separately and are not included in the repair scope.
Labor hours requested fit the extent of the work, and the repair plan calls for panel
straightening, paint blending, and replacement of the bumper cover. The billing
records reviewed show no repeated charges for the same operations.
